scope: Jurisdiction-level traveler consumption-tax policy only; this does not establish Rolex retailer participation, an individual purchaser's eligibility, or a guaranteed refund amount.

sources.publisher: Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau, Hong Kong SAR Government
sources.title: Prevailing Tax Policy

observedFacts: Hong Kong's prevailing tax policy states that there is no value-added or sales tax.
Accordingly, no jurisdiction-level traveler VAT or sales-tax refund scheme is identified for this market.
limitations: This finding does not address customs duty, retailer promotions, or taxes payable after import into another jurisdiction.
It does not establish any retailer-specific pricing or benefit.
